items.title: ‘Jailer 2’: Chethan D’ Souza on Rajinikanth’s style, humility and instinct for action
items.sum: Kannada stunt choreographer Chethan D' Souza secured his maiden collaboration on Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 after director Nelson Dilipkumar was impressed by his work in the Fahadh Faasil-starrer Aavesham. Nahta highlights that while Jailer 2 benefits from popular music and a South Indian base, films like Nayyi Navelli and Prahaar will rely heavily on word of mouth for growth.
